description: This file defines the MetaParser class, a utility for parsing HTML forms, tables, scripts, and related elements within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for extracting form contents, attributes, handling templates, and applying rules, primarily supporting dynamic form generation and customization.

classes.name: MetaParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and manipulating HTML and PHP files related to SugarCRM SuiteCRM form and view definitions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Placeholder method for parsing a file, currently returns 'NOT AVAILABLE'.

methods.name: getFormContents
methods.description: Extracts the contents within <form>...</form> tags from HTML content.

methods.name: getFormElements
methods.description: Parses HTML content to find input, select, and textarea elements.

methods.name: getFormElementsNames
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' attributes of form elements.

methods.name: getTagAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute from HTML tags.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns an array of table elements, optionally filtered by class.

methods.name: getElementsByType
methods.description: Extracts sections of HTML content matching specific tags.

methods.name: getElementValue
methods.description: Gets the inner content of a specific HTML element type.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes HTML comments from content.

methods.name: stripFlavorTags
methods.description: Removes flavor-specific tags based on global flavor setting.

methods.name: getMaxColumns
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of <td> elements in a table row.

methods.name: convertToTagElement
methods.description: Converts regex matches into structured tag elements.

methods.name: trimHTML
methods.description: Removes newlines, carriage returns, and tabs from HTML content.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Extracts and processes JavaScript blocks within HTML content, with Smarty syntax conversion.

methods.name: parseDelimiters
methods.description: Helper for parsing Smarty delimiters within JavaScript code.

methods.name: findAssignedVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to find the PHP variable assignment corresponding to an HTML tag, parsing PHP files.

methods.name: dirList
methods.description: Lists all non-dot files in a specified directory.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Detects if a form element is a custom field (ends with _c).

methods.name: applyPreRules
methods.description: Applies module-specific pre-parse rules to panels.

methods.name: applyRules
methods.description: Applies post-parse rules, including module-specific and general rules.

methods.name: applyPostRules
methods.description: Executes rules to process panels after initial parse.

methods.name: createFileContents
methods.description: Generates a PHP file defining a view's metadata, panels, and related code.

methods.name: mergePanels
methods.description: Merges custom panels with a master panel definition based on metadata.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges template metadata with a master copy, handling JavaScript paths.

methods.name: hasRequiredSpanLabel
methods.description: Checks if HTML contains a required field label.

methods.name: hasMultiplePanels
methods.description: Determines if a panels array contains multiple panels.

methods.name: getRelateFieldName
methods.description: Extracts related field name from a mixed array of IDs and names.

methods.name: getCustomPanels
methods.description: Returns custom panels, if any.

methods.name: fixTablesWithMissingTr
methods.description: Fixes table HTML missing <tr> tags around <td> elements.

methods.name: fixRowsWithMissingTr
methods.description: Fixes table rows where </tr> is followed immediately by <td>.

methods.name: fixDuplicateTrTags
methods.description: Removes duplicate consecutive <tr> tags.

methods.name: findSingleVardefElement
methods.description: Finds a unique vardef element within a set of form elements.
